title: נוער בסיכון בישראל תחת שמונה־עשרה שנות הנהגה: מדיניות, תקציב, קשב ציבורי ותוכנית פעולה ל־2026 ואילך
core_thesis: Israel improved the architecture for identifying, planning and coordinating services for children and youth at risk, but improved frontline continuity and equal execution less consistently.

verified_anchors.note: nominal endpoints, not a continuous inflation-adjusted series

policy_proposal.name: Anchor 360+ / StartOn 360+
policy_proposal.principle: No identified youth remains without a consistent adult, physical address and active digital contact channel.

pilot.estimate_status: report planning estimate, not a government commitment

core_kpis: NEET and education/employment persistence after age 18

methodological_limits: No single complete public annual series for all youth-at-risk expenditure from 2008 through 2026 was identified.
Definitions and coverage differ across agencies and years.
An increase in identified youth can reflect improved detection and geographic expansion.
Vepretski conceptual manuscripts referenced by the report are independent works and are not presented as peer-reviewed consensus.
